summary: Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date was Sam Altman reinstated as OpenAI CEO?”: 2023-11-21 (11 sources), 2023-11-29 (2 sources). A primary source says 2023-11-21.
Sources give 2 different answers to “How many board members did OpenAI have at the time of Sam Altman's firing?”: 4 (1 source), 6 (3 sources). No primary source found.
Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date was Emmett Shear named interim CEO of OpenAI?”: 2023-11-19 (6 sources), 2023-11-20 (2 sources). No primary source found.

Sources give 8 different answers to “How many of OpenAI's roughly 770 employees signed the letter demanding Sam Altman's reinstatement?”: 500 (1 source), 667 (1 source), 730 (1 source), 737 (1 source), 738 (2 sources), 743 (1 source), 747 (1 source), 97 (1 source). No primary source found.

Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date did Satya Nadella announce Sam Altman would join Microsoft to lead a new advanced AI research team?”: 2023-11-19 (1 source), 2023-11-20 (7 sources). No primary source found.

text: Sources agree that OpenAI's board fired Sam Altman as CEO on 2023-11-17, that Mira Murati became interim CEO on 2023-11-17, and that nearly all OpenAI employees signed the letter calling for his return on 2023-11-20. Sources disagree on when Altman was reinstated (2023-11-21 vs 2023-11-29), how many board members there were at the time of the firing (6 vs 4), when Emmett Shear was named interim CEO (2023-11-19 vs 2023-11-20), how many of the roughly 770 employees signed the letter (figures ranging from 500 to 747, plus 97), and when Satya Nadella announced Altman would join Microsoft (2023-11-19 vs 2023-11-20). A primary source gives 2023-11-21 where others say 2023-11-29; the other disputes have none.
